summary: Gulf_Union left the Ostafrikan meganation, citing a long period of inactivity and lack of support from the meganation.

evidence.document_type: Announcement posted by Manfaceman152 in a nation announcements channel, with an @here ping
evidence.key_text: @here Gulf_Union officially leaves the Ostafrikan Meganation. Due to inactivity and no support for a long period of time, we are leaving. We are also open to joining any other empires/meganations. Just dm me or msg me in game [Hoffywin9999] to talk about that.
evidence.timing: Posted 11:59 PM, rationale added 12:00 AM, and the offer to join another empire at 12:15 AM — the three parts are consecutive messages, roughly sixteen minutes apart.

analyst_notes: A meganation losing a member on the stated ground of inactivity is a decline indicator for the Ostafrikan meganation, and the sixteen-minute gap before advertising availability suggests the exit was decided in advance. The @here ping means this was pushed to every active member of the source server, so the departure is widely known — there is no chance this is quiet. The same player is the source of the recruitment signal captured separately.
why_it_matters: Fracture of a meganation, announced publicly and immediately advertised for re-recruitment. Inactivity-driven exits tend to come in clusters.
